summary: search honors its MCP read-only contract: read-only store open, missing-store early return, and 'search' added to learnHookSkipList so the learning initializer cannot create/migrate the DB before RunE.
reason: Greptile review (PR #1489) found a read-only MCP command could create and migrate local SQLite state — first via search's own writable Open, then via the generated learning pre-run hook that runs before RunE.
validated_outcome: Cold data dir: search exits 0 with empty result and creates zero files; existing store: hits unchanged (5 for 'transformers').
